clue.text: Bookmaker whose aides keep him in extras

indicators.note: the words whose aides are said to hold the prophet within them, so his name is found inside their letters

explanation.surface: A bookie whose assistants pay to keep him supplied with little luxuries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bookmaker' suggests a bookie, but here it is the author of a book of the Bible. The answer runs across wHOSE Aides; 'in extras' rounds out the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Hosea is one of the minor prophets and gives his name to an Old Testament book, so he is a maker of a book.

clue.text: Books rough footballers

parts.note: hard can mean rough or harsh
backs are defensive players in a football team

explanation.surface: Records are kept of footballers who play roughly.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardbacks are books bound in stiff covers.

clue.text: Start to sit on unoccupied edge

indicators.note: the opening letter of sit is taken

parts.note: idle means unoccupied, with nothing to do

explanation.surface: Someone begins to perch on a vacant ledge.
explanation.definitionFit: To edge is to move gradually and sideways, furtively, as in sidling.

clue.text: Verse starts making extra sense

parts.note: a poem whose opening letters of each line spell out a further message

explanation.surface: Lines of poetry whose beginnings carry a second meaning.
explanation.definitionFit: In an acrostic poem the initial letters of the lines spell a word or phrase.

clue.text: Officer making warship change direction

parts.note: a submarine, sub for short, is a warship
to alter is to change
N stands for north, a compass direction

explanation.surface: An officer orders a warship to turn about.
explanation.definitionFit: A subaltern is a junior army officer below the rank of captain.

clue.text: Finished a measure of drink

definitions.meaning: worn out or done for, as in a spent battery

explanation.surface: Someone has finished a tot of spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Shot means ruined or exhausted; a shot is also a small measure of spirits.

clue.text: In rugger, one bad scrum gets the bird

indicators.note: a scrum is a jumbled scrimmage, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A badly executed rugby scrum leads to jeering from the crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets the bird' hints at being booed, but 'the bird' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A budgerigar is a small Australian parakeet, a popular cage bird.

clue.text: Soldiers overcome with desire for glory

indicators.note: in a down clue, the soldiers end up beneath the desire, which sits over them

parts.note: lust is strong desire
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

explanation.surface: Troops are overwhelmed by a longing for military glory.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustre means glory or distinction, as in adding lustre to a name.

clue.text: Holding up an architectural drawing

definitions.meaning: a drawing showing one face of a building

explanation.surface: Someone raises a set of building plans.
explanation.definitionFit: Elevation is the act of raising; in architecture it is a drawing of a facade.

clue.text: It transmits sensations from cheek

definitions.meaning: a fibre carrying impulses between the brain and body

explanation.surface: Something carries feelings from the side of the face.
explanation.definitionFit: A nerve carries signals through the body; nerve also means brazen cheek.

clue.text: Rogue in novel, putting condition to gangster

parts.note: a rider is a condition added to an agreement
a hood (hoodlum) is a gangster

explanation.surface: A criminal in a book is made to accept terms from a mobster.
explanation.walkthrough: Rogue Riderhood is a villain in Dickens's novel Our Mutual Friend; 'putting ... to' sets the gangster after the condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Rogue Riderhood is the waterside villain of Dickens's Our Mutual Friend, a rogue in a novel.

clue.text: Deviate from perpendicular

definitions.meaning: to swerve off course, as a ship does
rising straight up, as a vertical cliff face does

explanation.surface: Something leans away from the vertical.
explanation.definitionFit: To sheer is to swerve aside; a sheer drop is a vertical one.

clue.text: Choice cut from right inside animal

indicators.note: the abbreviation for right goes within the word for animal

parts.note: a beast is an animal

explanation.surface: A butcher takes a prime joint from the right side of a carcass.
explanation.definitionFit: Breast of chicken or lamb is a prized portion of meat sold by butchers.

clue.text: Once again, make to relax

definitions.meaning: to produce something anew, a second time
to take leisure or amusement, as in recreation

explanation.surface: An instruction to build something a second time so as to unwind.
explanation.definitionFit: Hyphenated, re-create means make anew; recreate also means to refresh oneself with leisure.

clue.text: After start of symphony, fix place for slow movement

indicators.note: the following pieces come after the opening letter
the first letter of symphony

parts.note: to nail is to fix in place
a space is a place or spot

explanation.surface: A composer sets the position of an adagio following a symphony's opening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slow movement' suggests a symphony's andante, but means a crawl.
explanation.definitionFit: A snail's pace is a very slow rate of progress.

clue.text: Showing lung trouble, roughly speaking? Pin on cigarette

indicators.note: a rough, careless pronunciation of the words for showing lung trouble gives the first word

parts.note: coughing shows chest trouble; said roughly, the final g is dropped
a nail is a kind of pin used to fasten things

explanation.surface: A wheezing smoker is told to pin the blame for his chest on cigarettes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'roughly speaking' covers a careless pronunciation with the final g dropped; 'on' sets the pin after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Coffin nail is old slang for a cigarette, from its reputation for shortening lives.

clue.text: Money goes into setting up fatherless child

indicators.note: the money symbol is put inside the word for setting up

parts.note: founding is establishing or setting up
L stands for pounds sterling, from the Latin libra

explanation.surface: Cash is invested in establishing a home for an orphan.
explanation.definitionFit: A foundling is an abandoned infant whose parents are unknown.

clue.text: Implicitly seek one in school

definitions.meaning: to angle for something indirectly, as for compliments
a member of a shoal of swimming creatures, which is called a school

explanation.surface: Quietly looking for a classmate at school.
explanation.definitionFit: You fish for praise by hinting; a fish swims in a school, its group.

clue.text: Hay spread around exotic garden shrub

indicators.note: the scattered hay letters wrap round the rearranged garden letters
hay spread about is scattered, so its letters are rearranged
exotic signals a strange new arrangement of the letters of garden

explanation.surface: Straw is laid round an unusual plant in the garden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hay' and 'garden' look like a gardening scene, but both are anagram fodder; 'spread' and 'exotic' each signal a rearrangement and 'around' puts one inside the other. The definition is the last word alone.
explanation.definitionFit: The hydrangea is a flowering shrub with large heads of blooms.

clue.text: Novelist making a point, perhaps

definitions.meaning: in cricket, point is a ... position, so standing there is an example of this

explanation.surface: A writer is stating his argument.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, point is a fielding position near the batsman on the off side, so a player there is doing this.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry Fielding wrote Tom Jones; fielding is also playing in the field in cricket, at point for example.

clue.text: Pleased with oneself, putting trees back in

indicators.note: the word for trees is set backwards

parts.note: gums (gum trees, eucalypts) are trees

explanation.surface: A gardener is satisfied after replanting some trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone smug is self-satisfied and complacent.

clue.text: Sailing carelessly in the sea -— not shipshape

indicators.note: the jumbled letters of sailing go inside the sea's short name

parts.note: the Med, short for the Mediterranean, is the sea of many crosswords

indicators.note: sailing done carelessly is jumbled, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Sloppy sailing in the Mediterranean leaves the boat out of order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the sea' is the Mediterranean, known as the Med; 'carelessly' rearranges the fodder and 'in' places the result inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Something misaligned is out of line, the opposite of being in neat order.

clue.text: Sounds like Cockney lady's man is importunate

indicators.note: says the words that follow are pronounced like the answer

parts.note: her gent, said by a Cockney who drops the h

explanation.surface: A woman's partner from the East End is pushy in his demands.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockney is the London working-class accent that drops initial h.
explanation.definitionFit: Importunate means pressing or insistent in demands.

clue.text: International group giving dangerously laconic advice to motorists?

definitions.text: giving dangerously laconic advice to motorists?
definitions.meaning: read as two words, a light colour and a verb, it tells drivers to go across when the signal says stop

explanation.surface: A global body hands out terse and perilous tips for drivers.
explanation.definitionFit: The Red Cross is the international humanitarian movement; read as an order, red cross is reckless driving advice.

clue.text: Attention! Corps about to prepare for battle again

indicators.note: the corps letters go round the word for attention

parts.note: RM is the Royal Marines, a British corps
to give ear is to pay attention

explanation.surface: An officer shouts to the troops to get ready to fight once more.
explanation.definitionFit: To rearm is to equip oneself with weapons again ahead of a fight.

clue.text: Gas that's found in the blood

definitions.meaning: in physics, an ionised gas counted as a fourth state of matter
the straw-coloured fluid in which blood cells float

explanation.surface: A gas present in the bloodstream.
explanation.definitionFit: Plasma is both an ionised gaseous state of matter and the liquid component of blood.

clue.text: Namely, raise the first child

parts.note: sc. (scilicet) means namely

indicators.note: in a down clue the letters are read upwards

parts.note: No. I, number one, is the first

explanation.surface: An instruction to bring up the eldest child.
explanation.definitionFit: A scion is a descendant or heir of a family.

clue.text: Covers up blemish

indicators.note: in a down clue the letters are read upwards

parts.note: tops are lids or covers

explanation.surface: Someone hides a skin flaw with make-up.
explanation.definitionFit: A spot is a pimple or mark that spoils a surface.

clue.text: Live in Lincoln? I would!

indicators.note: the contraction for I would goes inside the president's nickname

parts.note: Abe was the familiar name of US president Abraham Lincoln
I'd is the contraction of I would

explanation.surface: Asked whether they would live in Lincoln, someone eagerly says yes.
explanation.definitionFit: To abide somewhere is to dwell or reside there.

clue.text: Telling a popular leader repeatedly to head revolt

indicators.note: the earlier pieces are placed in front of the word for revolt
the leading letter is taken twice over
the first letter of popular leads it

parts.note: a rising is a revolt or rebellion

explanation.surface: Informing a well-liked leader over and over that he must lead an uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: Apprising someone means informing them of something.

clue.text: It gets him moving with the utmost force

indicators.note: the letters are set in motion and rearranged

explanation.surface: Something gets a man going with great power.
explanation.definitionFit: Mightiest is the superlative of mighty, most powerful.

clue.text: Port in small measure found in part of India

indicators.note: the small measure is located within the name of the Indian region

parts.note: Goa is a state on India's west coast
an en is a printer's unit of width, half an em

explanation.surface: A harbour turns up in a small region of India.
explanation.definitionFit: Genoa is a major seaport in north-west Italy.
